# AI Evolution Data Directory

This directory stores data for the AI self-tooling framework:

- `analyzer_state.json` - Capability gap analyzer state
- `generated_tools/` - Generated tool implementations
- `tool_feedback.json` - Feedback on tool performance
- `evolution_history.json` - History of tool evolutions
- `knowledge_base/` - Crystallized knowledge patterns

## Data Privacy

All data stored here is local to the repository and not transmitted externally without explicit configuration.
